Name: Panda's Aika
Author: lilPolarPanda
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Panda's Aika[/size][/b][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q6a9D66.gif[/img][/center][center]
﻿Hi friend!

[i]This mod replaces the German Shepherd ("dog1") with me, Aika! I'm a Belgian Malinois and my mom Panda ([url=https://lilpolarpanda.carrd.co/]lilPolarPanda[/url]﻿) rescued me a couple years ago. Panda's friends adore me and always adopt the German Shepherd in the game to name it after me, so mom decided to make me into a proper mod! As you can see, I miss half an ear, which is kind of my trademark. Makes me look tough and cool! But don't worry, all I want is snuggles... [/i][/center]﻿[center]﻿[/center][u][img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]﻿

[/u]1) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2) Download the file & unzip/extract the file into your mods folder (/[font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]). ﻿
3) Run the game using SMAPI.

Have fun and feel free to message me if you have any questions <3

Manifest.Name: Panda's Aika
Manifest.Description: Adds Panda's dog as a pet.
